en: $s05That's a pointless worry, $s13Hayato.$/As long as we don't use it the wrong way, we're fine. $s80$s13Think about it simply: when it comes to power, the more the better.
note: Answers Hayato's worry (previous slice) that Shin Getter is too powerful; 'it' = Shin Getter.

en: $s30... $s80$s13$s05I suppose so.
$s05It took out that satellite in one hit!
note: Subject restored: Shin Getter Robo (destroyed the beam satellite in MF09).

en: With that thing, the Oni and the bugs will be easy-peasy!
note: Oni = the Hyakki Empire, bugs = the Insect Army. The drawn-out ~ rendered with playful wording instead of a tilde. Editorial: 'demons' -> 'Oni' (project decision for the Hyakki Empire's oni); 'easy-peasy' kept for Kaede's drawn-out playful tone.

en: ...Let's hope so.
$s05Schwartz!
note: Gai rebuking Schwartz's sour remark; the rebuke itself is implied by the next row.

en: The Insect Army is a seed you Japanese sowed! $s80$s13It's your duty to reap it yourselves!
But that was...
note: Trailing fragment kept; Schwartz completes her thought (the Hyakki Empire did it).

en: You're going to say it was the Hyakki Empire, right?!$/But listen, $s80$s13it was your job to protect the Institute. You were right there, and you still couldn't protect it. So it comes to the same thing!
note: Referent inferred: the institute is most likely the Tachibana Institute (attacked by the Hyakki Empire in MF06; the Getter Reactor blast is rumoured to have spawned the insects, MF08). Kept as 'the institute' without naming it. Accuracy: restored the duty in mamoru-beki omaera ('you, who should have protected it'), which 'right there to protect' left vague. Editorial: 'You want to say' -> natural 'You're going to say'; run-on split; 'Institute' capitalised (project rule); 'That makes it the same thing' -> 'So it comes to the same thing' (onaji koto da).

en: All super robot pilots from every nation, report to the briefing room immediately! $s80$s13I repeat...
Yesterday, $s80$s13one of our recon planes discovered $s80$s13$s80$s13this Hyakki Empire forward base.
What?! What is this?!
The forest all around it $s80$s13has withered away completely...!
Not just the forest. $s80$s13$s80$s13Every plant, $s80$s13$s80$s13animal $s80$s13$s80$s13and insect has been wiped out.
What in the world $s80$s13is going on here?
Most likely, $s80$s13$s80$s13it's a Hyakki Empire $s80$s13bioweapon factory.
$s05Bioweapons?!
Damn them... $s80$s13$s05making something like this...!
The bigger problem $s80$s13$s80$s13is what they've installed around the base: $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13these $s80$s13things that look like holes.
What are these...? $s80$s13$s80$s13$s05Missile silos?!
Most likely, these are $s80$s13$s80$s13long-range ballistic missile $s80$s13launch facilities.
Brother, $s80$s13with the Texas backing us up, $s80$s13we $s80$s13can sortie too!
note: Mary to Jack. 'we' = Mary and Jack (Texas Mack).

en: Sorry, but $s80$s13with us around, $s80$s13the rest of you won't $s80$s13get a turn at all-desu!
note: Jack's boast; mi-tachi ('Me' plural) rendered 'us' = Jack and Mary. Kept the -desu verbal tic.

en: $s80$s13$s05Hm? $s80$s13So the humans have sniffed us out!$/But it seems they noticed a little too late!$/Very soon, Kyoraiki loaded with germ bombs will be launched at nations all over the world! $s80$s13Let them watch, helpless!$/I leave the rest to you, %3Jyuboki!%0
note: KYORAIKI (Japanese kyo-rai-ki, 'giant thunder oni') is not in the glossary: guessed Hepburn reading; it is the Hyakki missile unit. Number unclear (one or several); written without an article so it works either way. 'Let them watch, helpless' = yubi wo kuwaete miteiru ga ii, addressed rhetorically to the absent humans.

en: $s05Yes, sir! $s80$s13Leave it to me, Emperor Burai!
$s05Not yet! $s80$s13$s05There's still time! $s80$s13$s05All units! Destroy the missiles before they launch!
...Truly a land of death...
Our objective this time $s80$s13$s80$s13is to destroy this facility.
- Preparing Missile Launch -
note: Event banner; leading spaces kept as in the source. Centering may need adjusting in the build.

en: - Missile Battery Destroyed -
note: Event banner read as 'battery destroyed' (shown when one is destroyed), like the other banners on this map (Mission Complete / Enemy Reinforcements / Mission Failed). Could also be an objective 'Destroy the Missile Batteries'.

en: Pardon me, but $s80$s13it's about time I launched those missiles!$/$s05Go! $s80$s13$s05Kyoraiki! $s80$s13Wipe out the foolish humans. $s80$s13$s05Fuhahaha...!
note: Kyoraiki: guessed reading, see MF10_0ADC.

en: This here's MAP 11!
note: Debug/placeholder map label.

en: $s80$s13$s20Hahahaha... $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20At last! $s80$s13At last it is complete!! $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20The ultimate, final weapon, mightier than Getter Robo!
$s05Yes, sir!
Countless high-energy readings in the sky above the Texas! $s80$s13At the center, $s80$s13a powerful electromagnetic wave seems to be forming!
$s05What did you say?!
Hyakki Beasts sighted!$/$f23b$s05Th-$s80$s13$s05there's a huge number of them!
note: Editorial: 'appearing' -> 'sighted' (natural report style for shutsugen); still subjectless report.

en: $s05Looks like they're finally getting serious!
$s05Looks like this'll be an all-out war...
$s05You've got some guts, $s80$s13$s05Hyakki Empire!
note: Editorial: the vocative joined with a comma; 'You've got some guts! Hyakki Empire!' read as two disconnected shouts.

en: Wh-$s80$s13what the?! What is that thing?!
Wh-$s80$s13what?! What is that?!
Look at the size of that thing!
$s20Fuhahahahaha...! $s80$s13$s20My dear Getter Team! $s80$s13$s20Are you astonished by the size of this %1Uzahra%0?
note: Opens Burai's speech that continues in the speakerless rows MF11_0566, 05D2, 0668, 06AE (same portrait). 'My dear' renders the mock-formal shokun.

en: $s80$s13...$s80$s13ji$s80$s13ra$s80$s13... come $s80$s13in! $s80$s13...Kujira, come in!
note: Garbled radio call. Kujira = the large transport plane (named in MF05 by Hayato), kept as a proper name so the broken syllables ji/ra still match. Editorial: garbled syllables ji/ra left joined (reads '...jira...', echoing 'Kujira'); spaces added so 'come in' does not run together.
Same text as the male version in Japanese; same English.

en: $s80$s13$s05$n! $s80$s13$s05So you're alive! $s80$s13Is everyone safe?
$s05Doctor! $s80$s13$s05What in the world...! $s80$s13$s05What just happened?!
$s80$s13Humans! $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20You shall learn the hard way $s80$s13$s20just how mighty our science is!
note: Clause order swapped for English; codes stay at the clause boundary.

en: $s20Assemble every Hyakki Beast! $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20We, the Hyakki Empire, $s80$s13$s20challenge humanity to the final battle!!
All super robots, $s80$s13emergency launch!
No wonder. $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20It was built with science and technology you could never hope to reach!
note: Speakerless: continuation of Emperor Burai's MF11_04DC (his portrait $f46).

en: This Uzahra is not merely big! $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20It has power and mobility far beyond Getter Robo's, $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20making it the mightiest weapon of all!
note: Continuation of Burai's speech.

en: Now then... $s80$s13$s80$s13$s20how kind of you to come all this way to greet me, but...
note: Continuation of Burai's speech; sarcastic politeness. Cut-off line, finished by the next row.

en: Die!
note: End of Burai's speech.

en: You've put up quite a fight, $s80$s13my dear Getter Team.$/...But $s80$s13I think it's time we ended this.$/$s05$f46dAll Hyakki Beasts! $s80$s13Annihilate the Getter Team with all your might!
...! $s80$s13The Hyakki Beasts that were standing still all this time...!$/$m07dEveryone! Be careful. $s80$s13The enemy's all-out attack is coming!
note: Source has 'seishi' (restrain) for 'seishi' (stand still), read as stationary. First sentence is a deliberate fragment (they start moving).

en: This here's MAP 12!
note: Debug/placeholder map label.

en: $s05Doctor! $s80$s13$s80$s13What in the world...! $s80$s13$s80$s13What just happened?!
note: Same line as MF11_0804 with different pauses; same English.

en: ...In all of human history... $s80$s13$s80$s13this may be the worst catastrophe yet...
note: Saotome's explanation continues in the speakerless rows MF12_0123 onward (next slice).

en: $s80$s13$s05Captain! $s80$s13$s05A transmission is cutting in on the Texas!
$s05What?! $s80$s13$s05Put it through to me.
$s05What?! $s80$s13$s05Captain! $s80$s13$s05Something has the Texas surrounded-desu!
$s05What?!
$s05Oh! $s80$s13$s05Brother! $s80$s13$s05Are those... Mechasaurs?! Or Hyakki Beasts?!
note: Plural chosen: the Texas is surrounded, so several units.

en: No way...! $s80$s13$s05The Dinosaur Empire and the Hyakki Empire were supposed to be gone...
$s05Hey! Captain! $s80$s13$s05What the hell is going on?!
$s05Is something attacking us?!
$s80$s13$s05! $s80$s13$s05...Could this be %3Lando%0's...?!
Did I surprise you, $s80$s13soldiers of the Allied Forces?
note: Rengo-gun rendered 'Allied Forces'. Speaker is Rasetsu, still unnamed (????). Editorial: vocative joined to the question ('Did I surprise you? Soldiers of the Allied Forces!' left the address dangling).

en: Who are you?!
My name is %3Rasetsu%0. $s80$s13$s80$s13$s80$s13By order of Lord Lando, I shall destroy the Texas!
note: Lando-sama rendered 'Lord Lando' (glossary only has Professor Lando / Lando).

en: $s05Lando?!
$s05Did you say Lando?!
